During the function of “Nalathittam Works” in Salem on 11.12.2021, the Hon’ble Chief Minister has announced that Preparation of Detailed ' Project Report will be taken up for “Construction of ROB at km 3/0 of Salem new Bypass road in lieu of existing LC.No.180 at Railway km 188/900-189/000 between Salem town and Ayothiyapattinam Railway Stations”.

2. Based on the above announcement, the Chief Engineer (Highways) Projects in the letter read above, has stated that this Salem New Bypass road (Km.0/0-5/0) SHU-54 connects Salem Corporation with Attur, Harur and Chennai. Salem New Bypass Road runs along the railway track and at 3/0, Veeranam road (Salem Corporation Road) joins the Salem new Bypass road as a T- Junction. Exactly at the centre of the Tjunction at 3/0, LC.No.180 is located (Ponnamapet Railway Gate). The railway portion separates the Salem new Bypass road and Ponnamapet urban settlements. Lots of Commercial shops, Hospitals, Residential buildings (around 60,000 people) and most importantly Indian Institute of Handloom Technology are located in these areas. Due to frequent closure of level crossing, acute and perennial traffic has been noticed. Hence, it is a long standing demand of the general public from this area to construct a flyover bypassing the Jevel crossing. As the TVU of the Existing LC.No.180 is 22427 (11/2021 census), this Level Crossing does not qualify for Construction of ROB/RUB under Railway Works Programme. As such, it is proposed to construct Road Over Bridge in lieu of existing LC.No.180 under Deposit work scheme with 100% funding by the State Government.

The Right Of Way of the Salem new Byepass road in the proposed ROB portion is around 13.00m (Avg) and the Right Of Way of the Salem Corporation road is 7.00m. Hence, land has to be acquired for the proposed construction. Construction of the proposed ROB will avert frequent traffic jams and accidents at this Level crossings.

Annexure-1 [G.0.(Ms.) No.612, Revenue and Disaster Management Department, dated 01.10.2021]

Guidelines for conducting Special Drive for error-correction in online land records of urban areas

(in Tamil Nilam — Urban land records database)

1. Objectives of the Special Drive:

Land records of urban areas were computerized during the years 2014 to 2016 by engaging data entry operators through outsourcing (private agencies) by the District Collectors concerned. The computerized data (land records) were converted into Unicode font and ported to Web-based Tamil Nilam — urban database (i.e., to the central server at the State Data Centre in Chennai) and completely online workflow-based maintenance and processing of the urban land records were commenced on various dates for various Towns/Corporations. Currently, applications for Patta transfers [(Involving Sub-Divisions (ISD) and Not Involving Sub Divisions (NISD)] are received through Common Service Centres (CSCs) RTR applications under district e-service architecture (user mapping). Also STR applications are received through online mode from the Sub-registrar offices.

Of late, petitions are received from landowners across the State alleging that data entry errors have crept-in in the computerized (online) data. Hence, a special drive for cleansing the data is warranted.

Giving due consideration to the,requests of public, the Honourable Minister for Revenue and Disaster Management has made an announcement in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly that the issues related to Patta would be resolved before the Pongal festival in the year 2022.
